rules: Every vault choice also opens the launcher compartment atomically.
Preview freely; commit explicitly. Exactly one scripted breach interaction, no free-position explosive simulation.
No currency requirement or mandatory purchase; no real-world explosive placement instructions.
Optional weapons create readable approach/control openings; no option replaces the unique core shot.
AETIMM and APY0C are the only agent identities. NPC armorer is deterministic game logic.
Host must save selected package and consumed charge BEFORE animation; interrupted breach restores same result.
Host must save warhead spent BEFORE projectile launch; interrupted shot never refunds ammo.
Miss or failed core opportunity: SI wins, player spared, squad health unchanged, clock continues.
Core hit records a hit; subsequent victory and Heaven/Hell routing require campaign logic, not automatic assumptions.
Theological endpoint names are provisional; original/polytheistic interpretation is permitted.

Existing signature weapons remain character-bound; endgame auxiliaries replace scavenged slot. Only selected anti-NSIE package can be active in encounter. No second package via sidekicks, loot, merchant or reload.
Resource depletion never grants another package; retain existing drop/pickup rules for the SAME physical item without refill.
No implicit leaderboard verification: trusted persistence, run IDs, event ordering and replay protection still need host implementation.
